inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada’s tightening of immigration and asylum rules under Bill C-12, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026, risks making people seeking safety pay for a political choice to securitize migration. Nigerians and others facing these rules are already navigating unequal power and precarious circumstances; harsher borders deepen that vulnerability instead of protecting people. This is an institutional failure that demands a rights-centered response.
